name: BioFlow
description:
BioFlow is a link-in-bio page with a built-in AI agent. The BioFlow connector lets Claude manage that page end-to-end: list and inspect your bio pages, edit the draft (add, edit, remove and reorder blocks — links, images, products, newsletter signups, booking embeds and more), create new pages, pull analytics (views, clicks, CTR, top links, referrers, tip revenue), and read captured leads and uploaded files. Twelve tools over Streamable HTTP: five read-only, five draft writes, and two publish tools.

Safety is built in. Every connection goes through OAuth with per-scope consent, and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never registered for the session, so Claude cannot see it or call it. Grants are listed and revocable in Settings > Connected AI apps. Draft edits never touch your live page. Publishing is double-gated: it requires a workspace-level "dangerous operations" toggle that is OFF by default, and every publish is two-step — Claude first receives a preview of exactly what would go live plus a short-lived confirmation token, and only a second, confirmed call commits it. Optimistic-concurrency checks refuse writes when the draft changed under Claude's feet, and every tool call is audited and visible in your dashboard.

The connector sells nothing in-chat, generates no images, video or audio, and serves no ads. Works on every BioFlow plan; usage rides your plan's normal limits.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BioFlow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BioFlow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.getbioflow.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BioFlow MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BioFlow provides these MCP tools: analytics.summary, contacts.list, file.list, page.add_block, page.create, page.get, page.list, page.publish, page.remove_block, page.reorder_blocks, page.schedule_publish, and page.update_draft.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BioFlow?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BioFlow in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
BioFlow requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BioFlow is developed by Devino Solutions. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
